_help: WHY? reels production plan (owner's Full Unique Pool, 21 Nov 2026). The daily writer makes the lowest-rank entry that is not done/skipped. A topic is done when a why_reels/*.py module has PLAN_RANK = rank.

reels.subject: Physics
reels.title: Why is the sky RED at sunrise/sunset but BLUE at noon?
reels.concept: Longer atmospheric path scatters blue; red survives
reels.notes: Highest visual + board classic; pairs with existing sky-blue reel
reels.skip: outside syllabus: CBSE 2026-27 Class 10 Science lists scattering 'excluding colour of the sun at sunrise and sunset'; sky-blue already made: blue_sky
